newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee gains vs dlr in thin trade, RBI quiet.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee gains vs dlr in thin trade, RBI quiet.

text.p: * Indian rupee appreciates beyond 35.70 per dollar in afternoon trade Friday on good supply, poor demand, dealers said
* Trades done at new seven-month high of 35.69 per dollar against Thursday's close of 735/745, they said.
* Reserve Bank of India (RBI) yet to buy dollars on Friday, dealers said.
* Trade thin, little demand for dollars, they said.
* In latest deals, dollar quoted 35.697/707 rupees.
